pull_requests.body:
I reconcile the audited 5.0 compiler/runtime branch with main through `ded3ee5a`, preserving the enclosing-function return contract, dependency-shadow defaults, lexical/module identity, private native artifacts, callback boundaries and expanded NanoISA/native lowering.

I repair Linux build and acceptance failures without suppressing strict warnings: generated runtime conditions, composed fixture bounds, process-capture diagnostics and native test signal supervision. I retain the stronger ownership and dynamic native representations where incoming branches carry older implementations.

Current Linux ARM64 evidence: bootstrap smoke checks, 33 ownership/record-pattern methods, 77 VM code-generation tests, 1,723 native translator checks, 1,073 shape checks, process capture and long-path regression pass. Native compiler acceptance, broad quick/full release gates, documentation and final scope reconciliation remain in progress. This draft is not authorization to bypass those gates or publish a tag.

Detailed reconciliation: `docs/evidence/main-reconciliation-pr334-linux.md`. Finalization ledger: `task_a8786d9cf2c1437fa46c7cfb8b99c30e`.
